notes.title: Scribble Space for Linux Patch
notes.content:
Hey all linux users. There was a bug that caused some users to have a pretty awful framerate. This has been fixed! 

Sorry about the annoyances caused by this, but you should be good to go now! If you find any bugs or have any problems, feel free to let me know how awful I am here: 

http://forums.wanderingcorgi.com/

I hope you're all enjoying the game!

notes.title: Small Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone. Two things today:

1. I fixed a bug with some systems not allowing controller input. Thank you to the user who messaged me, bringing my attention to the problem. Feel free to message me if you guys find anything else wrong!
2. My second game has just been Greenlit on Steam! Thank you everyone who voted for Forgotten Lore. It will be going up as Early Access soon - once I get Steam more heavily integrated into it.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hey all! Thanks for playing scribble space! I went through the discussion threads and posts all over the internet and put together a little buglist.

I fixed everything I saw mentioned, so I hope you enjoy. I appreciate everyone playing and giving such wonderful and informative feedback.

Fixes in this update..
1. Saving/Loading repeatedly no longer "jpeg"'s your ship in the editor.
2. You no longer get the "you won the game" achievement before actually winning the game.
3. Terrain shouldn't slightly desync when you pause the game.
4. "use frame" won't automatically be selected on the ship editor, unless you actually are holding the mouse for a full second.
5. Bosses are now 10x harder. 
6. There's now a little tutorial to explain controls that briefly pops up on the start of the first level.
7. Clicking the center of the screen no longer pauses the game. Also, all the other mobile controls have been removed from the Steam version - meaning you can't use the invisible touch analog stick anymore either. (my bad for leaving that stuff in)

If you find anything else, be sure to post about it in the discussion area of our community hub!
